title: Jiaonang Jihua: Qiji
description:
"Capsules Project" is a collection of domestically produced animated short films created by a professional team with mature animation production experience. With the creative theme of "extreme emotion + independent theme," it does not restrict the creative form, exploring the possibilities of animation together with the team. The aim is to collaboratively create original short films with diverse styles and characteristics, and to help Chinese animators reach the world stage. "Miracle" represents transcending conventions and breaking through limitations to achieve extraordinary success, often accompanied by a sense of mystery that inspires awe and curiosity. What miracles will occur in these 10 stories?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Di Ling Ai: Shui Xin Chan
description:
After the great war, chaos rose from the abyss, and darkness engulfed the earth like a tidal wave… Dimo ​​and the Water Emperor traveled to Rome to find a way to seal it, but chaos had already dragged the Ice Emperor and Yanhu into the abyss… A mysterious Tarot messenger appeared… The Ship King's backlash grew stronger, and Princess Du framed the Spirit Emperor but accidentally awakened the fairy in the icy cage. The group finally discovered the weakness of chaos… Can they work together to seal chaos? Can love and faith write a new myth?

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Zhangmen Didiao Dian
description:
As heavy snow blanketed the gates, demonic cultivators launched a surprise attack, slaughtering the entire Mo Sect. The young Lu Chaoge lost his closest relatives in the tragedy. Facing certain death, he awakened to a system that defied the heavens, narrowly escaping death through water-elemental spiritual awakening, and vowed to purge the world of demons and evil. After a decade of seclusion and arduous cultivation, he remained stuck at the Initial Realm, unable to make any progress. One day, a chance opportunity reactivated the system. He set out from the mountain with his younger sister, Lu Dongli, in search of spiritual herbs to break through his cultivation barrier. Along the way, he ingeniously solved a challenge posed by a strange beast, defied the heavens to summon nine Celestial Decrees to awaken his spiritual power, and broke through five cultivation realms in succession. He even faced down a challenge from a prodigy of the Sword Sect. The once-useless sect master thus began a powerful comeback.

(Source: Yuewen, translated)

title: Caishen Dou Zhanlong
description:
Taoist Cui accidentally released the treasure-gathering golden toad in order to read the heavenly book. The golden toad coveted the prosperity of the human world and reincarnated as a human, Dou Zhanlong. In order to avoid the heavenly calamity, the golden toad tore the three souls and seven spirits in Dou Zhanlong's spiritual cavity, creating nine clones, which fell into nine places respectively. The nine Dou Zhanlongs were in different parallel time and space, and each death gave rise to a new clone. They experienced "nine deaths and thirteen disasters" in total. Our story starts with the first Dou Zhanlong.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Taigu Shen Zun
description:
The supreme prince of the Spirit Realm was tragically murdered after being plotted against, and reborn into the mortal world as a lowly servant! Possessing an unparalleled creation elixir and heaven-defying cultivation techniques, he overturns the entire martial arts world with only a rusty sword. His dual martial souls awaken simultaneously, refining all spirits and comprehending the dual paths of divine soul cultivation. He traverses the Heavenly Demon Treasury, the Dragon Transformation Realm, and ancient ruins, acquiring supreme treasures such as the Demon Lord Armor and the Great Desolate Mirror. Various prodigies, sect parasites, and extraterrestrial evil races come to his death, but he crushes them all with a single sword strike! He subdues a dragon soul and a spirit dog, protects his beloved friends and family, surpasses Martial Kings, breaks through Martial Emperors, and ascends to Martial Venerable status. He confronts his two archenemies, Long Zhetian and Nangong Lingtian, tearing apart the long-buried conspiracy of ancient dark turmoil.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)
